description: Every environment variable the API server, LiveKit worker, Pipecat worker and sipbridge read. scripts/env-schema/generate.mjs builds environment-example, environment-example.polite-ai and docs/self-hosting/configuration.md from this file, and tests/env-schema.test.mjs checks that the code reads no variable missing from it.

groups.title: Core service
groups.description: Listen port, logging and how the services find each other.

groups.title: Access and secrets
groups.description: The first API key and encryption of stored secrets.

groups.title: Database
groups.description: PostgreSQL connection. The API server and the Jambonz worker connect directly.

groups.title: Model providers
groups.description: Set at least one. A provider whose key is unset is not listed in GET /models.

groups.title: Speech providers
groups.description: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech for pipeline (STT, LLM, TTS) rows. Speech-to-speech rows do not need them.

groups.title: LiveKit runtime
groups.description: LiveKit Cloud or a self-hosted LiveKit server. Unset means the livekit models are not listed.

groups.title: LiveKit pipeline defaults
groups.description: Defaults for pipeline rows on the LiveKit worker.

groups.title: Pipecat runtime
groups.description: The Pipecat worker. Unset means the pipecat models are not listed.

groups.title: Pipecat SIP gateways
groups.description: How the Pipecat worker reaches the phone network.

groups.title: Pipecat WebRTC tuning
groups.description: Browser sessions on the Pipecat worker. The defaults suit most installs.

groups.title: sipbridge
groups.description: The Go SIP gateway beside the Pipecat worker.

groups.title: Jambonz runtime
groups.description: An external Jambonz cluster for SIP calls. Unset means the jambonz models are not listed.

groups.title: Telephony and SIP
groups.description: Phone numbers, trunks and SIP registrations.

groups.title: Recording and stored audio
groups.description: Where call recordings and cached fallback messages are kept.

groups.title: Hosted sign-up and email
groups.description: User sign-up with better-auth, the waitlist and outbound email. Only needed beside a front end such as polite.ai. Off unless BETTER_AUTH_ENABLED=true. Run yarn auth:migrate once to create better-auth's own tables.

groups.title: Tuning
groups.description: Limits and timeouts. The defaults suit most installs.

groups.title: Set by the platform or the image
groups.description: You do not normally set these.

variables.name: WS_PORT
variables.description: HTTP and WebSocket listen port. Wins over PORT when both are set.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Listen port when WS_PORT is unset. Container platforms such as Cloud Run set it. The Pipecat worker listens on it.

variables.name: LOGLEVEL
variables.description: Log level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug or trace.

variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
variables.description: Extra browser origins allowed to call the API, comma separated. Needed when a front end is served from an origin other than the API's. Not needed behind a same-origin proxy.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Run mode: development (schema syncs at start, readable logs), production or staging (JSON logs). The yarn scripts set it.

variables.name: SERVICE_BASE_URI
variables.description: Base URL of the API server, without /api (for example http://localhost:4000), that the voice workers call back to.

variables.name: SHARED_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Token the voice workers send to the API as x-shared-token. It gives full access to every route, so use a long random value (openssl rand -hex 32). Needed when you run a worker.

variables.name: EXPOSE_PRIVATE_APIS
variables.description: Set to true to include the internal /agent-db routes in the published OpenAPI document.

variables.name: AGENT_TIMEZONE
variables.description: Time zone for the date and time an agent is given in its metadata.

variables.name: BOOTSTRAP_API_KEY
variables.description: First API key for a new instance. On a database with no users the server creates one organisation, one superAdmin user and this key at start. Ignored once any user exists. 32 characters or more. Or leave it unset and run yarn bootstrap.

variables.name: CREDENTIALS_KEY
variables.description: Key that encrypts stored SIP passwords and agent key material. Unset means they are stored in plain text, with a warning. Set it in every real deployment (openssl rand -base64 32) and never change it once data exists.

variables.name: AUTHENTICATE_USERS
variables.description: Removed. If it is still set the server warns and ignores it: every request needs an API key.

variables.name: B2BUA_HEARTBEAT_TOKEN
variables.description: Token that B2BUA nodes may use, instead of SHARED_API_TOKEN, to report themselves to POST /api/agent-db/b2bua-nodes.

variables.name: POSTGRES_HOST
variables.description: Database host.

variables.name: POSTGRES_PORT
variables.description: Database port.

variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
variables.description: Database name.

variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
variables.description: Database user.

variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.description: Database password. Use letters and digits only: it is also placed in a connection URL without escaping.

variables.name: POSTGRES_CA
variables.description: CA certificate (inline PEM) for a TLS connection. Setting it turns TLS on.

variables.name: POSTGRES_CERT
variables.description: Client certificate (inline PEM) for mutual TLS.

variables.name: POSTGRES_KEY
variables.description: Client key (inline PEM) for mutual TLS.

variables.name: POSTGRES_RO_SERVER_NAME
variables.description: Server name the certificate is checked against when POSTGRES_HOST is an IP address.

variables.name: POSTGRES_POOL_MAX
variables.description: Connections per process. Each process opens up to this many plus one for notifications.

variables.name: POSTGRES_POOL_MIN
variables.description: Minimum idle connections per process.

variables.name: POSTGRES_POOL_ACQUIRE_MS
variables.description: How long a query waits for a free connection.

variables.name: POSTGRES_POOL_IDLE_MS
variables.description: How long an idle connection stays open.

variables.name: DB_FORCE_SYNC
variables.description: Forces a full schema sync at start. Development mode and an empty database sync without it. Read docs/running.md before you set it in production.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenAI key: text models, and OpenAI Realtime and GPT-Live on the voice workers.

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
variables.description: Anthropic key: Claude text models.

variables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
variables.description: Google AI Studio key: Gemini text models, and Gemini Live on the LiveKit worker.

variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
variables.description: Gemini key for the Pipecat worker's Gemini Live and Gemini pipeline rows.

variables.name: GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID
variables.description: Google Cloud project for the Vertex AI Gemini driver.

variables.name: ULTRAVOX_API_KEY
variables.description: Ultravox key: the Ultravox runtime (no worker needed) and Ultravox rows on the voice workers.

variables.name: XAI_API_KEY
variables.description: xAI key: Grok text models and the Grok voice rows.

variables.name: GROK_API_KEY
variables.description: Older name for XAI_API_KEY, read when XAI_API_KEY is unset.

variables.name: DEEPSEEK_KEY
variables.description: DeepSeek key: DeepSeek text models.

variables.name: KIMI_KEY
variables.description: Moonshot key: Kimi text models.

variables.name: OPENROUTER_KEY
variables.description: OpenRouter key: OpenRouter text models.

variables.name: OPENROUTER_MODELS
variables.description: Extra OpenRouter model ids to list, comma separated.

variables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
variables.description: TypeSafe key for the text:typesafe/ decision rows. With TYPESAFE_BASE_URL set to https://openrouter.ai/api, OPENROUTER_KEY is used instead.

variables.name: TYPESAFE_BASE_URL
variables.description: TypeSafe API base URL.

variables.name: TYPESAFE_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Time budget for one TypeSafe decision, including its one retry.

variables.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
variables.description: ElevenLabs key: TTS on pipeline rows, ElevenLabs Agents rows, and the voice list.

variables.name: ELEVEN_API_KEY
variables.description: Older name for ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on the voice workers.

variables.name: ELEVENLABS_API_BASE
variables.description: Regional ElevenLabs API endpoint.

variables.name: ELEVENLABS_AGENT_PREFIX
variables.description: First part of the name of every ElevenLabs agent a worker creates, so deployments that share a workspace stay apart.

variables.name: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
variables.description: Deepgram key: speech-to-text on pipeline rows.

variables.name: CARTESIA_API_KEY
variables.description: Cartesia key: text-to-speech, and the voice list.

variables.name: NEUPHONIC_API_KEY
variables.description: Neuphonic key: text-to-speech, and the voice list.

variables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
variables.description: Path to a Google service account JSON file: Google speech, Vertex AI and GCS recording storage.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CREDENTIAL
variables.description: The Google service account JSON itself. At start the API and workers write it to the GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS path if no file is there.

variables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON
variables.description: Same as GOOGLE_CREDENTIAL, read when GOOGLE_CREDENTIAL is unset.

variables.name: GOOGLE_STT_LOCATION
variables.description: Google speech-to-text region on the Pipecat worker.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_URL
variables.description: LiveKit server URL (wss://...). Browsers connect to it too, so it must be reachable from them.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_API_KEY
variables.description: LiveKit API key.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
variables.description: LiveKit API secret.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_SIP_OUTBOUND
variables.description: SIP address of the outbound trunk the LiveKit worker uses for transfers and outbound calls (host[:port]).

variables.name: LIVEKIT_SIP_USERNAME
variables.description: Digest user name for that outbound trunk.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_SIP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Digest password for that outbound trunk.

variables.name: NUM_IDLE_PROCESSES
variables.description: Idle job processes the LiveKit worker keeps ready.

variables.name: DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: After SIGTERM, how long the LiveKit worker waits for calls to end before it exits.

variables.name: SETUP_FAILURE_CLEANUP_MS
variables.description: How long the LiveKit worker keeps a room after call set-up fails, before it removes it.

variables.name: TRANSCRIPT_USER_TIME
variables.description: Set to arrival to time a caller's transcript row by when the text arrived rather than when speech started.

variables.name: GOOGLE_SECRETENV_PATH
variables.description: Google Secret Manager path (projects/<n>/secrets/<name>) the image reads a secretenv pair from at start. Optional.

variables.name: SECRETENV_FETCH_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Attempts to read the secretenv pair from Secret Manager.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_USE_PROVIDER_KEYS
variables.description: true to run pipeline STT, LLM and TTS on your own provider keys instead of LiveKit Inference.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_LLM
variables.description: Default pipeline LLM.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_STT
variables.description: Default pipeline STT.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_STT_LANG
variables.description: Default STT language.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_TTS
variables.description: Default pipeline TTS.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_GOOGLE_TTS
variables.description: Google TTS voice for pipeline rows.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_GEMINI_TTS_MODEL
variables.description: Gemini TTS model.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_GEMINI_TTS_VOICE
variables.description: Gemini TTS voice.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_ELEVENLABS_MODEL
variables.description: ElevenLabs TTS model on provider keys.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_PIPELINE_CARTESIA_TTS_MODEL
variables.description: Cartesia TTS model on provider keys.

variables.name: GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI
variables.description: true to reach Gemini through Vertex AI on the LiveKit worker.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
variables.description: Google Cloud project for Vertex AI on the LiveKit worker.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION
variables.description: Google Cloud region for Vertex AI on the LiveKit worker.

variables.name: PIPECAT_WORKER_URL
variables.description: URL the API dispatches Pipecat sessions to.

variables.name: PIPECAT_DISPATCH_TOKEN
variables.description: Bearer token on dispatch calls. Same value on the API and the worker.

variables.name: PIPECAT_JOIN_SECRET
variables.description: Secret that signs browser join requests. Same value on the API and the worker.

variables.name: PIPECAT_PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Public URL of the Pipecat worker that browsers connect to.

variables.name: PIPECAT_SELF_IP
variables.description: This worker's own IP address, to tell its own WebRTC peers from others.

variables.name: WORKER_USER_ID
variables.description: User id the Pipecat worker writes on invocation log lines it cannot attribute.

variables.name: WORKER_ORGANISATION_ID
variables.description: Organisation id for those lines.

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: Address the Pipecat worker binds to.

variables.name: RELOAD
variables.description: Set to reload the Pipecat worker when its code changes (development).

variables.name: GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS
variables.description: How long the Pipecat worker waits for calls to end at shutdown.

variables.name: HEALTHZ_MAX_SESSIONS
variables.description: Sessions above which the Pipecat health check fails.

variables.name: HEALTHZ_MAX_THREADS
variables.description: Threads above which the Pipecat health check fails.

variables.name: HEALTHZ_MAX_GATEWAY_ENTRIES
variables.description: Gateway entries above which the Pipecat health check fails.

variables.name: HEALTHZ_MAX_TASKS
variables.description: Tasks above which the Pipecat health check fails.

variables.name: SIP_GATEWAY
variables.description: Telephony gateway: sipbridge, freeswitch, voiceblender or daily.

variables.name: PIPECAT_SIP_OUTBOUND
variables.description: Outbound SBC for calls the sipbridge gateway places: host[:port][;transport=tls|tcp|udp].

variables.name: PIPECAT_SIP_USERNAME
variables.description: Digest user name the gateway presents to the outbound SBC.

variables.name: PIPECAT_SIP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Digest password for the outbound SBC.

variables.name: PIPECAT_SIP_FROM_DOMAIN
variables.description: Domain in the From header of outbound INVITEs.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_BASE_URL
variables.description: REST URL of the sipbridge the worker controls.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Bearer token on sipbridge REST calls. Same value on the worker and sipbridge.

variables.name: ESL_POLLER_URL
variables.description: URL of the FreeSWITCH esl-poller.

variables.name: ESL_POLLER_TOKEN
variables.description: Token for the esl-poller. Falls back to CALL_API_TOKEN.

variables.name: CALL_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Shared token for the FreeSWITCH call API and worker events.

variables.name: WORKER_EVENT_TOKEN
variables.description: Token on events the gateway sends to the worker. Falls back to CALL_API_TOKEN.

variables.name: VOICEBLENDER_BASE_URL
variables.description: Voiceblender REST URL.

variables.name: VOICEBLENDER_API_KEY
variables.description: Voiceblender API key.

variables.name: VOICEBLENDER_APP_ID
variables.description: Voiceblender application id.

variables.name: VOICEBLENDER_WORKER_WS_BASE
variables.description: WebSocket base URL Voiceblender uses to reach the worker.

variables.name: VOICEBLENDER_VSI_TOKEN
variables.description: Token for the Voiceblender event subscription. Falls back to VOICEBLENDER_API_KEY.

variables.name: DAILY_API_KEY
variables.description: Daily API key (SIP_GATEWAY=daily).

variables.name: DAILY_API_URL
variables.description: Daily API URL.

variables.name: WEBRTC_ICE_SERVERS
variables.description: STUN and TURN URLs, comma separated. Empty disables them.

variables.name: WEBRTC_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Browser origins allowed to open a session, comma separated.

variables.name: WEBRTC_PEER_HOST
variables.description: Host name that resolves to every worker, used to route a browser's follow-up requests to the worker that owns its session.

variables.name: WEBRTC_PEER_PORT
variables.description: Port of the other workers.

variables.name: WEBRTC_PEER_DNS_TTL_S
variables.description: How long a peer lookup is cached.

variables.name: WEBRTC_PEER_TIMEOUT_S
variables.description: Timeout for a request to a peer worker.

variables.name: WEBRTC_OUTPUT_CUSHION_MS
variables.description: Audio buffered before playback starts.

variables.name: WEBRTC_OUTPUT_TARGET_MS
variables.description: Target playback buffer.

variables.name: WEBRTC_OUTPUT_MAX_MS
variables.description: Largest playback buffer before audio is trimmed.

variables.name: WEBRTC_STRETCH_QUIET_DBFS
variables.description: Level below which audio counts as quiet for stretching.

variables.name: WEBRTC_STRETCH_EVERY
variables.description: How often a quiet frame may be stretched.

variables.name: WEBRTC_TRIM_EVERY
variables.description: How often a frame may be trimmed.

variables.name: WEBRTC_UNDERRUN_LOG_MS
variables.description: Gap size from which playback underruns are logged.

variables.name: WEBRTC_UNDERRUN_STATS
variables.description: Set to 0 to turn off underrun counting.

variables.name: WS_TRACE
variables.description: Set to 1 to log every WebSocket frame.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SIP_SIGNAL_IP
variables.description: Public IP address sipbridge puts in SIP headers.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SIP_SIGNAL_PORT
variables.description: SIP port.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SIP_BIND_IP
variables.description: Local address for SIP.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SIP_UDP_DISABLED
variables.description: true to turn off SIP over UDP.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SIP_TLS_PORT
variables.description: SIP over TLS port.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_TLS_CERT_FILE
variables.description: TLS certificate file.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_TLS_KEY_FILE
variables.description: TLS key file.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_TLS_AUTO_SELFSIGNED
variables.description: Make a self-signed certificate when no files are given.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SRTP_ENABLED
variables.description: Offer SRTP.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SRTP_REQUIRED
variables.description: Refuse calls without SRTP.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SRTP_DTLS_ENABLED
variables.description: Allow DTLS-SRTP.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SRTP_OUTBOUND
variables.description: Offer SRTP on outbound calls.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_MEDIA_IP
variables.description: Public IP address for RTP.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_MEDIA_BIND_IP
variables.description: Local address for RTP.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_RTP_PORT_MIN
variables.description: Lowest RTP port.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_RTP_PORT_MAX
variables.description: Highest RTP port.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_RTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Seconds without RTP before a call is ended.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_RTP_SILENCE_FILL
variables.description: Send silence when the worker sends no audio.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_WORKER_WS_BASE
variables.description: WebSocket base URL of the Pipecat worker.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_API_BIND_ADDR
variables.description: REST API listen address.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log level.

variables.name: SIPBRIDGE_SIP_TRACE
variables.description: Log every SIP message.

variables.name: JAMBONZ_SERVER
variables.description: Jambonz API host name.

variables.name: JAMBONZ_API_KEY
variables.description: Jambonz API key.

variables.name: JAMBONZ_AGENT_NAME
variables.description: Public DNS name of the Jambonz worker that Jambonz calls back to.

variables.name: APLISAY_OUTBOUND_TRUNK_ID
variables.description: Trunk id that outbound and carried legs leave on, for billing and outbound call authorisation. Set the same value on the API and both workers.

variables.name: REGSERVER_REGISTRAR
variables.description: Host name customers' PBXes register to. Unset means registrar accounts cannot be created. Permanent once the first account exists.

variables.name: PBX_REGISTRAR_DOMAIN
variables.description: Host name desk phones of the phone system register to. Unset means REGSERVER_REGISTRAR is used. Permanent once the first phone line exists.

variables.name: PBX_RELEASE
variables.description: Which phone system features the API accepts: 1, 1c, 2, 3 or 4. Unset means 1. An organisation also needs the phoneSystem capability.

variables.name: CALLCTL_SHARED_TOKEN
variables.description: Token call control sends as x-callctl-token. It opens /api/agent-db/pbx and nothing else. Unset means those routes are closed. Use a long random value (openssl rand -hex 32).

variables.name: REGCLIENT_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Token for the B2BUA node API (SIP traces and registration probes). Unset turns those routes off (503).

variables.name: REGCLIENT_API_TOKEN_PREVIOUS
variables.description: The previous token, accepted while a new one rolls out.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_API_PORT
variables.description: B2BUA node API port.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_API_SCHEME
variables.description: B2BUA node API scheme.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_CA_CERT
variables.description: CA certificate (PEM or base64 PEM) that signs node certificates.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_API_INSECURE
variables.description: Development only: skip TLS checks on the node API.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Time limit for the first request to an unknown node.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_CAPABILITY_TTL_MS
variables.description: How long a node's support for traces is remembered.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_UNSUPPORTED_TTL_MS
variables.description: How long a node's lack of support is remembered.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_PROBE_NODES
variables.description: Nodes that may probe a registration no node has claimed.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_NODE_ALLOWLIST
variables.description: Only these node addresses may be contacted.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NODES
variables.description: Allow node addresses in private ranges.

variables.name: REGCLIENT_USE_PRIVATE_NODE_ADDRESS
variables.description: Reach nodes on their private address.

variables.name: TRACE_PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Time limit for a trace request to a node.

variables.name: REG_SIM_ENABLED
variables.description: true to turn on the registration simulator (testing).

variables.name: RECORDING_STORAGE_PATH
variables.description: Where call recordings go: gs://bucket/prefix (Google Cloud Storage), s3://bucket/prefix (S3 or an S3-compatible store) or file:///directory (a directory the workers and the API share). Unset means recording is off, except that a process with Google credentials keeps the old default bucket gs://llm-voice/<NODE_ENV>-recordings.

variables.name: S3_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Endpoint of an S3-compatible store, for example http://minio:9000. Unset means AWS S3 in S3_REGION.

variables.name: S3_REGION
variables.description: S3 region.

variables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: S3 access key id.

variables.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: S3 secret access key.

variables.name: S3_SESSION_TOKEN
variables.description: S3 session token, for temporary credentials.

variables.name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
variables.description: true to address the bucket in the URL path (most S3-compatible stores), false for a bucket host name.

variables.name: FALLBACK_MESSAGE_STORAGE_PATH
variables.description: Where cached fallback messages go: gs://bucket/prefix. Defaults to a folder beside the recordings.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_ENABLED
variables.description: true to turn on better-auth user sign-in beside API keys.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Random secret of 32 characters or more.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
variables.description: Public base URL of this API, used to build OAuth callback URLs.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Front-end origins allowed to call the auth routes, comma separated.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION
variables.description: true to require a verified email address before sign-in.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Google OAuth client id for Google sign-in.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Google OAuth client secret.

variables.name: AUTH_PROXY_SECRET
variables.description: Secret a proxying front end sends to have its end user's IP address trusted for rate limits.

variables.name: AUTH_EMAIL_PER_ADDRESS_HOURLY
variables.description: Emails per address per hour from the reset and verification routes.

variables.name: AUTH_EMAIL_PER_ADDRESS_DAILY
variables.description: Emails per address per day.

variables.name: AUTH_EMAIL_GLOBAL_HOURLY
variables.description: Emails per hour in total.

variables.name: WAITLIST_CALLBACK_URL
variables.description: Where the waitlist confirmation link sends the user.

variables.name: POLITE_SITE_URL
variables.description: Origin of the front end that receives Google sign-in hand-offs.

variables.name: ADMIN_USER_IDS
variables.description: User ids allowed to call the admin /api/users routes, comma separated.

variables.name: EMAIL_SEND_TYPE
variables.description: smtp2go to send email. Unset means emails are written to the log.

variables.name: EMAIL_SEND_KEY
variables.description: SMTP2GO API key.

variables.name: EMAIL_SEND_URL
variables.description: Override for the SMTP2GO send endpoint.

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
variables.description: Sender address.

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM_NAME
variables.description: Sender name.

variables.name: EMAIL_BRANDS
variables.description: Sender personas as inline JSON (lib/auth/email-brands.js).

variables.name: EMAIL_BRANDS_FILE
variables.description: Path to a JSON file of sender personas.

variables.name: CALL_LOG_RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: Requests per principal per window to the call log routes.

variables.name: CALL_LOG_RATE_WINDOW_MS
variables.description: Window for that limit.

variables.name: CALL_LOG_MAX_CONCURRENT
variables.description: Call log reads in flight per process. Kept below POSTGRES_POOL_MAX.

variables.name: CALL_LOG_QUEUE_WAIT_MS
variables.description: How long a call log read waits for a slot before 503.

variables.name: CALL_LOG_QUEUE_MAX
variables.description: Call log reads that may wait.

variables.name: AGENT_CONCURRENCY_STORE
variables.description: Store for concurrency counters. Keep sql.

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_MAX_RETRIES
variables.description: Anthropic SDK retry count.

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Anthropic request timeout.

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_CACHE_TTL
variables.description: Prompt cache lifetime for Anthropic: 5m or 1h.

variables.name: OPENAI_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: OpenAI request timeout.

variables.name: OPENAI_COMPAT_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Timeout for OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, xAI).

variables.name: SUBAGENT_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Time limit for a subagent or agent invoke.

variables.name: SET_BUILDER_MODEL
variables.description: Model the agent-set builder uses. The builder is off, and GET /api/health says so, when this model's provider has no key.

variables.name: SET_BUILDER_MCP_URL
variables.description: MCP server the agent-set builder reads the API reference and docs from. The builder sends requests to it.
variables.default: https://mcp.aplisay.com/mcp (https://mcp-next.aplisay.com/mcp when NODE_ENV is development or staging)

variables.name: SET_BUILDER_MAX_TOKENS
variables.description: Output token limit for the builder.

variables.name: TEXT_CHAT_MAX_TOOL_HOPS
variables.description: Tool call rounds allowed in one text chat turn.

variables.name: TEXT_CHAT_HANDOFF_WAIT_MS
variables.description: How long a process waits for another to hand over a chat session.

variables.name: TEXT_CHAT_HANDOFF_BUSY_WAIT_MS
variables.description: The same wait when the owner is busy with a turn.

variables.name: TEXT_CHAT_STATE_MAX_BYTES
variables.description: Largest chat state saved for another process to resume.

variables.name: TEXT_CHAT_REATTACH_GRACE_MS
variables.description: How long a disconnected chat session can be resumed.

variables.name: TEXT_CHAT_HEARTBEAT_MS
variables.description: How often a process marks its chat sessions as alive.

variables.name: TEXT_CHAT_LIVENESS_GRACE_MS
variables.description: Missed heartbeat time after which another process may take a session.

variables.name: USAGE_STALE_SESSION_HOURS
variables.description: Age after which an unfinished usage session is closed.

variables.name: APLISAY_STUB_MODEL
variables.description: Set to 1 to list text:stub/echo, a text model that repeats its input and needs no provider key. For smoke tests only: never set it in production.

variables.name: RUNTIME_STATS_MS
variables.description: Interval for event loop and CPU samples on the LiveKit worker.

variables.name: PROFILE_MS
variables.description: Length of a CPU profile window on the LiveKit worker.

variables.name: PROFILE_DIR
variables.description: Where CPU profiles are written.

variables.name: PROFILE_INTERVAL_US
variables.description: CPU profile sampling interval.

variables.name: PROFILE_ROLE
variables.description: Which processes to profile: all, supervisor or job.

variables.name: PROFILE_ON_EXIT
variables.description: Set to 1 to write a profile when a process exits.

variables.name: PROFILE_SIGNAL
variables.description: Set to 1 to start and stop profiles with SIGUSR2.

variables.name: BUILD_COMMIT
variables.description: Commit the image was built from. Set by the image build.

variables.name: BUILD_BRANCH
variables.description: Branch the image was built from. Set by the image build.

variables.name: BUILD_TAG
variables.description: Tag the image was built from. Set by the image build.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_WORKER_PREBUILT
variables.description: Set by the API image: the LiveKit registry is already built, so prestart skips the build.

variables.name: HOSTNAME
variables.description: Host name, used to name this process in the database.

variables.name: POD_NAME
variables.description: Kubernetes pod name, used in place of HOSTNAME.

variables.name: K_SERVICE
variables.description: Set by Cloud Run. Counts as Google credentials when RECORDING_STORAGE_PATH is unset.

variables.name: TMPDIR
variables.description: Temporary directory.

variables.name: SECRETENV_KEY
variables.description: Key for SECRETENV_BUNDLE. Optional: see docs/running.md.

variables.name: SECRETENV_BUNDLE
variables.description: The whole environment, encrypted. Optional.
